description: This source file implements utility functions for handling proxy server strings, including parsing and converting proxy schemes, host:port strings, and URI representations within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Represents a proxy server with scheme, host, and port information.

methods.name: GetSchemeFromPacTypeInternal
methods.description: Parses the proxy type string from PAC to a ProxyServer::Scheme enum.

methods.name: FromSchemeHostAndPort
methods.description: Constructs a ProxyServer object from a scheme, host, and port string.

methods.name: ConstructHostPortString
methods.description: Creates a host:port string from hostname and port number.

methods.name: PacResultElementToProxyServer
methods.description: Converts a PAC string element to a ProxyServer object.

methods.name: ProxyServerToPacResultElement
methods.description: Converts a ProxyServer object to its PAC string representation.

methods.name: ProxyUriToProxyServer
methods.description: Parses a URI string into a ProxyServer object, with optional default scheme.

methods.name: ProxyServerToProxyUri
methods.description: Converts a ProxyServer object into a URI string.

methods.name: GetSchemeFromUriScheme
methods.description: Returns the ProxyServer::Scheme enum from a URI scheme string.
